name: RYR1
summary: RYR1 (MH), malignant hyperthermia - a dominant disorder, so every copy shows and there is no silent carrier. It costs the horse nothing day to day: the real condition is episodic, triggered by anaesthesia or hard stress, and a horse between episodes is an ordinary horse.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: Malignant hyperthermia
phenotypes.description: One copy of the RYR1 variant. The horse is completely normal to look at and to ride - the fault only shows under anaesthesia or extreme stress, which is why the condition is screened for rather than spotted.

phenotypes.name: Malignant hyperthermia (two copies)
phenotypes.description: Two copies of the RYR1 variant, and no normal calcium channel left. The horse overheats and stiffens under any real exertion, and has fewer hearts for it.
